'''G-05''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] located by [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Spaceport]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Hazeen]] to contact an Imperial-affiliated individual regarding [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] rebel activities.<ref name="The Rebel Secrets" />
